name: TNT Minecraft
description: 9 TNT -> 1 compressed TNT, 10 tiers, each 9x the destroyed volume of the last (radius 8/17/36/75/128). Fuse-timer GUI on right-click for EVERY TNT (even vanilla): 0-3600 s. Dirt/Stone/Crop/Wood TNT: 4 material + 4 gunpowder, clears its material in a 10x10x10 area with zero damage and drops the items. Tunnel TNTs: 3 TNT in a row/column -> bores a straight tunnel with an arrow marker. TNT-Infused gear: 8 TNT + any armor/tool -> armor blocks 90% of explosion damage, tools get a 4-8% chance of a small blast. Friendly bow-tie creepers (pink=female, blue=male) spawn in the day, breed with bone meal/coal, and explode when hit. English + Persian.
